prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE NEW professional contemporary graphic logo for Chinese company 达州礼林生态科技有限责任公司, brand 礼林生态 / LILIN ECO. Prefer a strong unique silhouette and a few broad shapes over dense hidden lettering. Derive subtle structure from 礼 turn/open hook and 林 paired support without forcing complete characters. Construction: A COMPACT ORTHOGONAL THREE-WAY COORDINATE MARK: three SHORT thick right-angle arms meet at ONE shared off-center elbow, each ends in a broad square terminal of different length. Exactly three component solids; two arms split once at their join, source from 林. A small open lower return carries 礼 gesture. Silhouette like a clever modular junction, NOT a plus sign, arrows, atom, medical cross or diagram with thin lines. Palette: Near-black ink, strong turquoise and vivid sunflower yellow. PURE WHITE background, one centered standalone emblem with ample margins. DO NOT render any words or captions; a neutral company wordmark will be added separately for comparison. Medium visual weight with generous white cuts, crisp vector-like flat artwork. No mockup, decorative illustration, texture, 3D, shadows, global rainbow wash, generic stock icon, business-icon collage or copied established logo.
